title: Bank Holidays: Why July 11 Sees Banks Closed Across India
description: Public and private sector banks across India are closed today, July 11, due to the second Saturday rule. This closure is a standard practice implemented by th.

faq.q: Are all banks closed on the second and fourth Saturdays?
faq.a: Yes, all public and private sector banks across India are mandated to remain closed on the second and fourth Saturdays of every month, as per RBI guidelines.

faq.q: Can I still use net banking and mobile banking on bank holidays?
faq.a: Absolutely. Digital banking channels like net banking and mobile banking apps are fully operational 24/7, allowing you to perform most transactions without interruption.

faq.q: Do NEFT and RTGS transactions work on bank holidays?
faq.a: Yes, both NEFT and RTGS systems operate 24x7, including bank holidays. You can initiate and complete electronic fund transfers at any time.

faq.q: What happens if I deposit a cheque on a bank holiday?
faq.a: Cheques deposited on a bank holiday will typically be processed on the next working day when the bank reopens. The clearing cycle will begin from that point.

faq.q: Are ATMs operational on bank holidays?
faq.a: Yes, ATMs remain operational for cash withdrawals and other basic services on bank holidays. Banks usually ensure sufficient cash availability, but it's advisable to plan for critical cash needs.
